query: NVIDIA AMD GAAP versus non-GAAP gross margin difference
normalized: amd difference gaap gross margin non nvidia

output.content:
Using the latest reported quarters—NVIDIA fiscal Q2 2027 ended July 26, 2026, and AMD Q2 2026 ended June 27, 2026—NVIDIA reported a **75.0% GAAP gross margin and 75.0% non-GAAP gross margin**, a **0.0-percentage-point** difference. [[1]] 

AMD reported a **54% GAAP gross margin and 56% non-GAAP gross margin**, so its non-GAAP measure was **2 percentage points (200 basis points) higher**; gross profit rose from **$6.203 billion GAAP** to **$6.488 billion non-GAAP**. [[2]] [[3]] 

On a cross-company basis, NVIDIA’s gross margin exceeded AMD’s by **21 percentage points on GAAP** (75% versus 54%) and by **19 percentage points on non-GAAP** (75% versus 56%). [[1]] [[3]] 

The reason the relative gap narrows on a non-GAAP basis is that AMD excludes items including stock-based compensation, amortization of acquisition-related intangibles, and certain other items from its gross-profit reconciliation, whereas NVIDIA’s reported GAAP and non-GAAP gross-margin percentages were identical in the latest quarter. [[3]] [[1]]
